page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-8-lssd is an arm64-based virtual machine instance belonging to the c4a server family. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The instance is equipped with NVMe SSD local storage, configured as 2 local SSDs, though the exact capacity is not specified in the hardware profile. There are no GPUs associated with this instance type, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The arm64 architecture of the c4a-highmem-8-lssd provides a resource-dense profile suitable for memory-intensive workloads that benefit from dedicated CPU allocation. With 8.0 GB of RAM per core, this instance is designed to handle tasks requiring significant memory capacity relative to compute resources. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the arm64 architecture offers a favorable resource-to-cost ratio for workloads that do not require x86-specific instruction sets. The inclusion of NVMe SSD local storage supports applications requiring low-latency disk access. This hardware configuration is appropriate for memory-optimized workloads, database caching, and general-purpose tasks requiring a high memory-to-CPU ratio.
